description: This file implements notification handling for media upload events, including waiting for media attachments, managing event lists, and sending notifications via communication service. It includes functions for initializing and destroying notification message targets, and handles media events like video and image uploads.

methods.name: removeOldEvents
methods.description: Removes media events older than specified age from a list.

methods.name: mediaUploadEventListener
methods.description: Handles media upload events, adding them to appropriate lists and signaling.

methods.name: waitForNotification
methods.description: Waits for a specific media event with matching rule and event IDs, or times out.

methods.name: notificationActionHandler
methods.description: Handles notification actions, waits for media if needed, and sends messages.

methods.name: notificationMessageTargetInit
methods.description: Initializes notification message targets, registers event listener, and actions.

methods.name: notificationMessageTargetDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up notification message targets and unregisters event listener.
